summary: Comprehensive testing of Resume Builder upgrade completed. All 14 features tested successfully. Import entry screen with 4 options (Upload, Paste, Start From Scratch, LinkedIn Coming Soon) working. Paste → Parse → Review → Editor flow working with confidence system. Score panel V2 with 7 categories (100pts total) and 15 improvement rules working. Fix All Easy Issues button applies action verbs and metric placeholders. Backend APIs /api/career-tools/improve-bullet and /api/career-tools/improve-summary responding correctly.
passed_tests: Resume Builder page at /career-tools/resume-builder loads with import entry screen showing 4 options
Upload Resume option (data-testid='upload-drop-zone') visible with DOCX/PDF badges
Paste Resume Text option (data-testid='paste-option') visible and clickable
Start From Scratch option (data-testid='scratch-option') visible and clickable
LinkedIn Import option (data-testid='linkedin-option') visible with 'Coming soon' badge
Click 'Start From Scratch' transitions to editor with tabs (Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras)
Score panel V2 (data-testid='resume-score-panel-v2') visible with 7-category breakdown

Score categories: Completeness (20pts), Professional Presence (10pts), Experience Quality (20pts), Impact & Metrics (20pts), Skills & Relevance (10pts), Structure & Readability (10pts), ATS Safety (10pts)
Click 'Paste Resume Text' shows paste textarea (data-testid='paste-textarea') with Parse Resume button
Paste resume text and parse: fills personal details, experience, skills from structured text
Import Review screen shows confidence summary with High/Medium/Needs Review badges
Continue to Editor button navigates to editor with parsed data
Score panel shows improvement suggestions with severity icons (critical=red, high=amber, medium=blue) and +points badges
Fix All Easy Issues button (data-testid='fix-all-btn') appears and applies improvements
Import button (data-testid='new-import-btn') in editor navigates back to import entry screen
Reset button (data-testid='resume-reset-btn') clears all data and returns to entry screen
Template selection works (Clean, Professional, Minimal, Executive, Modern)
Live preview updates when personal details are edited
Download PDF button visible and functional
Print button visible
Backend /api/career-tools/improve-bullet endpoint responds to POST requests with improved bullet and suggestions
Backend /api/career-tools/improve-summary endpoint responds to POST requests with improved summary and word count
Backend /api/health returns healthy status
Backend /api/career-tools/email-templates returns list of templates (regression)
